title: Maddux-Army collision
summary: On 21 April 1929, a midair collision occurred between a United States Army Air Corps PW-9D fighter and a Maddux Air Lines Ford 4-AT-B airliner near San Diego. The collision killed six persons.
probable_cause: The two aircraft occupied the same airspace near San Diego without awareness of each other, resulting in a midair collision.

title: Jask air disaster
summary: Mail flight from United Kingdom to India on night landing attempt at Jask Airport. Pilot misjudged altitude during approach, aircraft stalled and crashed, destroying landing gear and damaging port wing. Post-crash fire started when wing-mounted landing flare ignited fuel spilled from damaged tanks, killing the pilot, mechanic and passenger.
probable_cause: Pilot misjudged the aircraft's altitude during night landing attempt, causing aerodynamic stall and crash impact; subsequent fire from wing-mounted flare ignited fuel spilled from damaged tanks.
